glossary.definition: The role accountable for decisions and review of a defined process.
An agreed statement of where mapped work starts and ends, identifying the inputs received, outputs handed off, and decisions for which the owner is responsible.
The transfer of an output from one role or process to a receiving role, considered complete only when the receiver has what it needs to act.

reviewedChapters.title: Process mapping software for quality management in Canadian operations
reviewedChapters.summary: All six dimensions pass. The introduction page aligns with its plan brief, covers all three assigned subsections without scope drift, and provides the required ordered overview of the nine-chapter guide. Both assigned source URLs are cited accurately and support their sentences; one permitted internal site path (/solutions/processes/) is used consistently. Vendor descriptions are distinguished from verified installed behavior throughout. The illustrative example is correctly labeled as hypothetical and not presented as a measured customer result. Prose is clear and readable with no significant repetition across sections. No FAQ section appears, which is correct as none is assigned to this introduction chapter. The three glossary terms (Process owner, Process boundary, Handoff) introduced in the body are already defined in context.glossary with identical wording; the page does not restate or reword them, merely uses the labels in context. No new terms requiring glossary entries are introduced. Roles, records, and decisions extracted below reflect only what the introduction page explicitly names.
